definitions.gloss: heavy responsibility; important duty; important post
definitions.explanation: A position or duty that carries significant responsibility and weight. Used formally to describe roles that require great commitment.

examples.japanese: {重任|じゅうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|にな}う→担う：12787_ninau⟧。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{重任|じゅうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}けた→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧。
examples.english: I accepted the weighty responsibility of being company president.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{重任|じゅうにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}いた→就く：10123_tsuku⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|こた}えよう→応える：09893_kotaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}した→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧。
examples.english: Having taken on an important position at a young age, he worked hard to meet the expectations of those around him.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used in business, politics, and official contexts. Emphasizes the weight and seriousness of a responsibility or position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重任|じゅうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|にな}う→担う：12787_ninau⟧ (to bear a heavy responsibility)
- {重任|じゅうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ (to fulfill an important duty)
- {重任|じゅうにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧ (to take on an important post)
- {重任|じゅうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧ (to accept a weighty responsibility)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {重責|じゅうせき}: heavy responsibility — very similar, emphasizes the burden
- {大任|たいにん}: important task — emphasizes the scale of the duty
